title: Infosys Theater at MSG to Host NXT Stand & Deliver During WrestleMania 43 Weekend
excerpt: WWE's marquee NXT event and official WrestleMania watch parties will take place at the Indian tech giant's namesake venue in Manhattan, extending New York's role as a WrestleMania companion city.
body:
• WWE announced that Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden will host NXT Stand & Deliver and AAA Eternal Glory during WrestleMania 43 weekend in April 2027.
  • The venue will also host official WrestleMania 43 watch parties on both nights, with giant LED screens and fan activations.
  • WrestleMania 43 itself will take place in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia — the first time the event has been staged outside North America.
  • The Infosys naming rights at MSG represent one of the most visible examples of Indian corporate branding in mainstream American entertainment.

NYC to Serve as WrestleMania 43 Companion City

WWE announced on July 20 that the Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden will host three marquee events during WrestleMania 43 weekend in April 2027: NXT Stand & Deliver, the NXT brand's flagship annual event; AAA Eternal Glory, a showcase from the Mexican lucha libre promotion; and official WrestleMania 43 watch parties on both Saturday and Sunday nights.

The announcement transforms New York City into a companion destination for WrestleMania weekend, even as the main event takes place thousands of miles away in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. WrestleMania 43 will be the first edition of WWE's premier event ever held outside North America, announced in September 2025 through a partnership between WWE and Saudi Arabia's General Entertainment Authority.

The watch parties at Infosys Theater will feature giant LED screens, brand activations, merchandise, and immersive fan experiences. WWE and Fanatics, the sports merchandise company, will also deliver interactive fan experiences and exclusive WrestleMania 43 retail activations across New York.

Infosys Brand Front and Center at MSG

The Infosys Theater — a versatile venue within the Madison Square Garden complex that seats several thousand fans — has become a regular home for WWE's NXT brand. The venue hosted NXT Roadblock in both 2025 and 2026, as well as NXT Gold Rush in November 2025, establishing it as a key stop on NXT's live events calendar.

For Infosys, the Bengaluru-headquartered IT services giant, the naming rights deal with MSG represents one of its most prominent brand investments in the United States. Having the company's name attached to WrestleMania weekend — one of the most-watched entertainment events globally — delivers visibility that extends far beyond traditional corporate sponsorships.

"NXT Stand & Deliver, AAA Eternal Glory, and the official WrestleMania 43 watch parties will create a city-wide moment for fans to celebrate the global two-night event."

— WWE Official Announcement

The Infosys Theater branding appears across all WWE programming filmed at the venue, reaching audiences through Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network, and The CW — a distribution footprint spanning more than one billion households worldwide in over 20 languages.

Indian Tech's Growing Presence in American Sports

The WrestleMania announcement is the latest example of Indian technology companies expanding their brand presence through American sports and entertainment partnerships. Infosys has been building its consumer-facing visibility through strategic sponsorships, complementing its core enterprise IT services business.

For the Indian diaspora in New York and the broader Northeast, the Infosys Theater at MSG has become a recognizable landmark — a tangible marker of Indian corporate success in the heart of Manhattan. The venue sits atop Penn Station, one of the busiest transit hubs in North America, ensuring daily exposure to millions of commuters and visitors.

However, the theater's future carries some uncertainty. Plans for the renovation of Penn Station, reported by The Gothamist in May 2026, include designs that would require demolishing the theater to build a new glass entrance on Eighth Avenue. While those plans remain in early stages, they could eventually force WWE and Infosys to find alternative arrangements.

WrestleMania's Global Expansion

The decision to host WrestleMania 43 in Riyadh while maintaining a robust event presence in New York reflects WWE's strategy of globalizing its biggest property. As part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO), WWE has been expanding internationally, with Saudi Arabia emerging as a major market.

Ticket information and additional event details for the Infosys Theater events will be announced in the coming months. Fans can register for updates at wwe.com/WM43Weekend.
